row: 港珠澳大橋橫跨珠江口伶仃洋，全長約 55 公里，由跨海橋梁、兩座人工島與約 6.7 公里的海底沉管隧道組成，2009 年動工、2018 年 10 月通車。

airspace.zh: 港珠澳大橋橫跨中國大陸、香港與澳門三地空域，橋區及香港國際機場周邊嚴格限制飛行；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: The bridge crosses mainland, Hong Kong and Macao airspace; flying near it and Hong Kong International Airport is tightly restricted. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 橋、島、隧道，55 公里連起三座城市
tagline.en: Bridges, islands and a tunnel: 55 km linking three cities

zh: 珠江口的伶仃洋上，
港珠澳大橋連接香港、珠海與澳門，全長約 55 公里。
en: Over the Lingding Channel at the mouth of the Pearl River,
the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge links three cities across about 55 km.

zh: 它由橋、島、隧道組成：
西段是長長的跨海橋，東段潛入海底隧道。
en: It is made of bridges, islands and a tunnel:
a long sea viaduct in the west, and a tunnel under the sea in the east.

zh: 三座通航孔橋之中最大的是青州航道橋，
主跨 458 公尺，「中國結」造型的橋塔高 163 公尺。
en: The largest of its three navigation bridges is the Qingzhou channel bridge:
a 458 m main span between "Chinese knot" towers 163 m tall.

zh: 江海直達船航道橋有三座「海豚」造型的鋼塔，
讓往來江海的船隻從橋下通過。
en: The Jianghai channel bridge has three steel "dolphin" towers,
letting river-and-sea vessels pass beneath.

zh: 靠近珠海的是九洲航道橋，
「風帆」造型的橋塔高 120 公尺，主跨 268 公尺。
en: Nearest Zhuhai is the Jiuzhou channel bridge,
with "sail" towers 120 m tall and a 268 m main span.

zh: 橋段在海上綿延二十多公里，
一座座橋墩整齊地排向遠方。
en: The bridge runs on for more than twenty kilometres over the sea,
pier after pier marching into the distance.

zh: 橋到這裡上了西人工島，
道路從島上潛入海底。
en: Here the bridge lands on the west artificial island,
and the road dives under the sea.

zh: 海底沉管隧道長約 6.7 公里，
黃色虛線標出它在海面下的位置。
en: The immersed tunnel under the sea is about 6.7 km long;
the yellow dashes mark where it runs beneath the surface.

zh: 隧道在東人工島回到海面，
再接上通往香港口岸的香港接線。
en: The tunnel surfaces again at the east artificial island
and joins the Hong Kong Link Road to the Hong Kong port.

zh: 香港端的口岸位在機場旁的人工島上，
大橋讓三地的車程大幅縮短。
en: The Hong Kong port stands on an artificial island beside the airport;
the bridge has cut journey times between the three cities sharply.

zh: 接下來三部影片，看它的結構、施工與影響。
橋面高度、橋墩間距與橋塔外形為示意估計。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: The next three films look at its structure, its construction and its impact.
Deck levels, pier spacing and tower forms are estimates.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

title.zh-Hant: 港珠澳大橋：結構與技術

tagline.zh-Hant: 三座通航孔橋、人工島與海底沉管
tagline.en: Three channel bridges, artificial islands and an immersed tunnel

zh: 大部分橋段是一跨接一跨的連續梁橋，
主梁以鋼箱梁為主，全橋用鋼約 42 萬噸。
en: Most of the bridge is a long run of girder spans,
mostly steel box girders, using about 420,000 tonnes of steel in all.

zh: 青州航道橋是雙塔斜張橋，
塔頂的鋼結構「中國結」把兩支塔柱連在一起。
en: The Qingzhou bridge is a two-tower cable-stayed bridge;
a steel "Chinese knot" at the top ties each tower's two legs together.

zh: 主跨 458 公尺，
讓大型船隻從橋下的主航道通過。
en: Its 458 m main span
leaves the main shipping channel open beneath it.

zh: 江海直達船航道橋的三座鋼塔立在中央分隔帶，
只用一個索面拉住橋面。
en: The three steel towers of the Jianghai bridge stand in the central reserve
and hold the deck with a single plane of cables.

zh: 九洲航道橋的「風帆」塔，
呼應珠江口自古以來的海上航運。
en: The "sail" towers of the Jiuzhou bridge
recall the age-old shipping of the Pearl River estuary.

zh: 兩座人工島各長 625 公尺，
是橋梁與海底隧道之間的轉換點。
en: Each artificial island is 625 m long,
the changeover point between bridge and tunnel.

zh: 沉管隧道由 33 節巨型沉管組成，
埋在海床下，最深處距海面 40 多公尺。
en: The immersed tunnel is made of 33 huge sections
laid in the sea bed, at its deepest more than 40 m below the surface.

zh: 東段改走海底，是因為靠近香港國際機場有飛航高度限制，
而且要讓出大型船舶的航道。
en: The eastern part goes under the sea because of height limits near Hong Kong International Airport,
and to keep a channel clear for very large ships.

zh: 大橋以 120 年的使用年限設計，
並採用大型高阻尼橡膠隔震支座。
en: The bridge was designed for a service life of 120 years
and sits on large high-damping rubber bearings that isolate it from earthquakes.

zh: 2018 年 9 月颱風「山竹」來襲，
瞬間最大風速每秒 55 公尺，結構仍在設計範圍內。
en: When Typhoon Mangkhut struck in September 2018,
with gusts of 55 m/s, the structure stayed within its design limits.

zh: 橋、島、隧道三種結構接成一體，
是港珠澳大橋最大的特色。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: Bridge, islands and tunnel joined into one crossing
is what sets this project apart.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 從 2009 年動工到 2018 年通車
tagline.en: From the start of work in 2009 to the opening in 2018

zh: 2009 年 12 月 15 日，港珠澳大橋動工。
在那之前，伶仃洋上只有往來的船隻。
en: Work on the bridge began on 15 December 2009.
Before that, only ships crossed the Lingding Channel.

zh: 先在海中築起兩座人工島，
作為隧道的出入口。
en: First two artificial islands were built in the sea
to serve as the tunnel portals.

zh: 33 節沉管在岸上預製，再浮運到海上，
一節一節沉放到海床的基槽裡。
en: The 33 tunnel sections were made on shore, floated out
and sunk one by one into a trench dug in the sea bed.

zh: 西段的橋段大量採用預製構件，
在工廠做好橋墩與鋼箱梁，再運到海上吊裝。
en: The western bridge was largely prefabricated:
piers and steel box girders were made in factories and lifted into place at sea.

zh: 三座通航孔橋的橋塔先後立起，
再以鋼索拉住主跨的橋面。
en: The towers of the three navigation bridges went up in turn,
and their cables took hold of the main spans.

zh: 香港一側的接線與口岸，
也在人工島與海上同步施工。
en: On the Hong Kong side the link road and the port
were built at the same time on reclaimed land and over the sea.

zh: 2017 年，海底隧道最後接頭安裝完成，
主體工程全線貫通。
en: In 2017 the final joint of the undersea tunnel was put in place
and the main works were joined from end to end.

zh: 2018 年 10 月，大橋開通。
從構想、協調三地到完工，歷經多年。
en: The bridge opened in October 2018,
after many years of planning and of agreement between the three places.

zh: 工程在繁忙的航道、白海豚棲地與颱風季中進行，
施工時要兼顧航運與生態。
en: The work went on amid busy shipping lanes, white dolphin habitat and typhoon seasons,
balancing navigation and the environment.

zh: 施工畫面為示意，
實際工程依海況與航道分區分段進行。
en: The construction scenes are illustrative;
the real work went zone by zone to suit the sea and the shipping.

zh: 將近九年的工程，
在伶仃洋上連起了三座城市。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: Nearly nine years of work
joined three cities across the Lingding Channel.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

title.zh-Hant: 港珠澳大橋：功能與影響
title.en: Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: Use and Impact

tagline.en: A new distance between the two shores of the estuary

zh: 大橋通車後，香港到珠海、澳門的車程，
從約 3 小時縮短到約 45 分鐘。
en: Since the bridge opened, the drive from Hong Kong to Zhuhai and Macao
has fallen from about three hours to about 45 minutes.

zh: 過去往來香港與珠海、澳門，主要靠渡輪或繞行陸路，
大橋讓三地第一次有了直通的道路。
en: Travel between Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macao used to mean ferries or long road detours;
the bridge gave them their first direct road link.

zh: 它是粵港澳大灣區的重要連結，
串起人流、物流與觀光。
en: It is a key link in the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area,
carrying people, goods and tourists.

zh: 三地的交通規則與口岸制度不同，
車輛過橋需要配合通關與許可安排。
en: The three places have different traffic rules and border systems,
so vehicles crossing the bridge need clearance and permits.

zh: 大橋也成了觀光景點，
有遊客專程搭車或坐船來看它。
en: The bridge has become a sight too,
with visitors coming specially by coach or by boat to see it.

zh: 珠江口是中華白海豚的棲地，
施工與營運期間的生態保育一直受到關注。
en: The estuary is home to Chinese white dolphins,
and protecting wildlife during construction and operation has drawn close attention.

zh: 龐大的投資與實際車流之間的落差，
也曾引發外界的討論。
en: The gap between the huge investment and the traffic actually using it
has also been debated.

zh: 橋、島、隧道的組合，
為跨海通道工程累積了大量經驗。
en: Combining bridge, islands and tunnel
has built up a great deal of experience for sea crossings.

zh: 夕陽下的伶仃洋，
一條道路從海上一路延伸到天邊。
en: The Lingding Channel at sunset:
a road running across the sea all the way to the horizon.

zh: 港珠澳大橋的四部影片到此結束。
歡迎到「AERO 無人機模擬飛行」親自飛一趟。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: This ends the four films on the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge.
Come and fly here yourself in the AERO drone flight simulator.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.
